newsitem.title: USA: Autonomous to do $9 mln private placement.
newsitem.headline: Autonomous to do $9 mln private placement.

text.p: Autonomous Technologies Corp said Tuesday it has agreed to sell three million shares at $3 per share to accredited investors as part of a private placement.

The company said it will use the proceeds to market its T-PRK(R) laser system in Europe and Canada as it continues efforts to obtain U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval for marketing the system in the United States.
Proceeds will also cover costs of clinical trials, new product development, other on-going operations, capital expenditures and working capital, it said.
The private offering will result in the company having about 9.9 million shares of common stock outstanding, it said.
"With this financing, we will have significantly broadened institutional ownership of our stock," chairman and chief executive officer Randy Frey said in a press release.
The closing of the purchase is conditioned upon a resale registration statement covering the privately placed shares being effective by the Securities and Exchange Commission, the company said.
The company will file a resale registration statement within a few days, the company said. The placement agent for this offering is Everen Securities Inc.
